description: Thread widget caps (cmux.widget/1). Every writer (acpmux) and every reader (the agent pane, the Swift host, iOS) applies the same numbers. A byte cap counts the UTF-8 bytes of a string, or of compact JSON (no insignificant whitespace) for a value. A count cap counts items. The JSON Schemas carry the caps that JSON Schema can express; the others are checked in code against this file.
